description: Orbit404 is tackling the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge: an interactive map that ranks landing sites near the Moon's south pole by slope, sunlight, Earth visibility and distance to water-ice craters, using NASA LRO data. Led by a CS Master's student at Universitaet Paderborn. Looking for teammates in Python/geospatial data, web dev (maps/React), ML, or design & video. Fully virtual, English/Hindi. Let's find the best spot on the Moon together!
